frozenPlan.boundary: Reuse own frozen fractional-autumn forecast physicalAutumnBoundaryDayIndex: descending root delta(t)=72-latitude in the existing solar carrier. No search using source clocks.
frozenPlan.rule: delta=72-latitude; H16=acos((sin(-16deg)-sin(latitude)*sin(delta))/(cos(latitude)*cos(delta))); Delta=4*(180deg-H16). Fixed original q from baseline season. N=1440+R(t)-S(t); Bi=S(t)+q*N; Bf=R(t)-q*N-Delta. k=1+Delta/(q*N).
frozenPlan.control: At same t, keep original q and k=18/16. This reuses a previously rejected boundary interpretation; it is a control, not another new candidate.
frozenPlan.arithmetic: t and Delta from binary64 are converted to exact binary rationals, then horizon interpolation and endpoint/factor/quota equations use exact fractions. No source seconds inferred. Record Delta angular-root floating precision separately.
frozenPlan.test: Check each B against affine_value(source cells,t), and q against coupled quotient interval at t,k. Report Fajr/Isha/joint membership for every case and trim. Compare k to free-q/free-location projected sets as an additional relaxed screen. Report the seam J=q*N/8-Delta; no taper or city-specific correction is added.
frozenPlan.limits: Failure rejects this boundary interpretation only under current horizon, source-cell and affine-run assumptions. Success would not determine outer crossings, preserve continuity or demonstrate a full calendar; no production promotion.
